description: This file defines the GoalsRepository class responsible for managing goal data. It provides methods to list existing goals and to create or update goals via REST API calls or mock data, depending on configuration.

classes.name: GoalsRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing goal data, including listing and upserting goals via REST API or mock data.

methods.name: listGoals
methods.description: Retrieves a list of goals, either from mock data or via an API call.

methods.name: upsertGoal
methods.description: Creates or updates a goal with specified type and target, returning the resulting Goal object.
